verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI's first-party durable execution docs say agents can preserve their progress across application errors or restarts and support long-running workflows, which is the core of this story. Separately, serializable message history lets a conversation be continued. Missing for 10: documentation of the checkpointing mechanism and the exact-resume semantics (which step or tool call execution resumes from), and independent or hands-on corroboration of crash recovery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can checkpoint agent state so a run can resume exactly where it left off after a crash or restart

citations.quote: Pydantic AI allows you to build durable agents that can preserve their progress across transient API failures and application errors or restarts, and handle long-running, asynchronous, and human-in-the-loop workflows with production-grade reliability.
These messages can be used both to continue a coherent conversation, and to understand how an agent performed.
